source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: When extracting a helper, explain when callers must use it and what state it intentionally leaves to callers. The accepted UpdateSortInfo comment says it must precede an actual sort or rebuild and does not update primary type/order; review simplified the contract wording. Avoid repeating implementation variable names when the caller needs behavior and ordering. Keep necessary identifiers in comments when they identify a real dependency, as the custom-column explanation does.
title: Helper comments should state the call contract and limits
